description: Labeled turns for the turn site at turn-v4. Keys under expect name questions: direct, dispatch, architecture and direction are graded as probabilities, and shape as the winning option's mass. Labels say what should happen, not what a past session did. turn-v2 cases, its old holdout included, are all fit for turn-v4 because they informed no new wording's score; their orientation label became architecture. The cases after them alternate fit and holdout within each authored class, and the holdout was committed before any score on it existed. A holdout is scored once against cuts chosen on fit.
